# Finsai Trade — Full Reference

> Finsai Trade (Mauritius) Ltd is an FSC-regulated multi-asset online trading broker offering Forex, Crypto, Stocks, Indices, and Metals CFDs through MetaTrader 5 (MT5).

This file expands on llms.txt with full page-level detail for language models and other automated readers that need more context than the summary file provides.

---

## Company Overview

**Legal entity:** Finsai Trade (Mauritius) Ltd
**Regulator:** Financial Services Commission Mauritius (FSC)
**License No.:** GB25204899
**Company No.:** C228371
**Incorporated:** 19 November 2025
**Registered address:** 3 Emerald Park, Trianon, Quatre Bornes 72257, Mauritius
**Physical address:** 3rd Floor, Manor House, 30 St Georges Street, Port Louis, Mauritius

Finsai Trade positions itself as a multi-asset broker "built by traders," combining execution, education (Finsai Academy), IB partnerships, loyalty rewards, and social trading into one ecosystem. Marketing claims include 50,000+ traders, 120+ countries served, and several industry awards (World Forex Award, Innovative Startup Award, World Finance Award 2024/2025).

**Restricted regions:** Finsai Trade does not accept clients from the United States, Cuba, Iraq, Myanmar, North Korea, Sudan, or the UAE.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/about, https://finsaitrade.com/regulations

---

## Regulations & Compliance

Finsai Trade holds an investment dealer license from the Financial Services Commission Mauritius. Stated compliance pillars: Security & Transparency, Regulated Trading, Secure Payments, Regular Audits & Reporting, Global Standards Compliance, and Financial Controls. The site states client funds are held in segregated accounts at tier-1 banking institutions, separate from corporate operating funds, and that the company applies SSL encryption, multi-factor authentication, and AML/KYC procedures.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/regulations

---

## MT5 Trading Platform

MetaTrader 5 is offered as the core trading platform, available on Windows, Mac, Linux, web browser (MT5 WebTrader), and mobile. Stated features:

- Trade Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, CFDs, and Precious Metals from one platform
- 80+ built-in technical indicators (platform overview page separately cites 38 built-in + 2,000+ custom indicators and 44+ charting tools)
- 21 timeframes for market analysis
- Algorithmic trading via MQL5, Expert Advisors (EAs), and custom indicators
- VPS hosting for uninterrupted automated trading
- Multi-Account Management (MAM) support

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/mt5, https://finsaitrade.com/platform

---

## Platform Overview

Three trading environments are presented:

1. **MT5** — the primary desktop/web/mobile trading platform (see above).
2. **Social Trading** — copy trading and strategy-provider platform (see below).
3. **Finsai Trade App (Coming Soon)** — mobile app in development, planned to offer 1,000+ instruments, live news, demo trading, and copy trading/expert signals.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/platform

---

## Social Trading

An integrated copy-trading platform, separate login portal at social.finsaitrade.com. Stated stats: 10,000+ active investors, 150+ strategy providers, $2.4M+ volume copied (marketing figures, not audited).

**For investors:** browse strategy providers, view win rates/risk scores, auto-copy trades, set drawdown limits and risk controls, monitor via dashboard.
**For strategy providers:** trade normally on your own account, followers mirror trades automatically, earn performance-based monthly payouts.

The FAQ on this page states copy trading is distinct from a PAMM/managed account: the investor retains full ownership and withdrawal control of their own funds, and no third party has direct withdrawal access.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/social-trading

---

## Accounts

| Tier | Target | Min. Deposit | Spread | Commission | Swap | VPS | Dedicated Manager |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smart Choice | New retail clients | $100 | 1.4 pips | None | Swap-free | No | No |
| Smart Pro | Mid-tier traders | $1,000 | 0.6 pips | None | Swap-free | No | No |
| Smart ECN | Advanced traders | $5,000 | 0.0–0.1 pips | $0.03 | Swap-free | Yes | Yes |

All account types allow algo/bot trading and support hedging (Smart ECN also supports netting). Account opening flow: Sign Up → Verify (KYC) → Fund → Start Trading.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/accounts

---

## Payments

Deposit/withdrawal channels referenced on-page: cards, UPI, e-wallets, cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, USDT icons shown), and bank transfer. Claims: PCI DSS-compliant processing, 2FA on partner integrations, withdrawals processed within 1 working day (marketing claim, not a contractual SLA), and all withdrawals settled in the wallet's base currency.

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/payments

---

## Partnerships (Introducing Broker Program)

Finsai Trade's IB program offers rebate-based commissions, an earnings calculator (based on referred client trade volume — the site notes calculator output is illustrative, based on a single instrument (Gold), and not a guarantee), multi-tier structure, and reporting via a partner portal. Marketing stats cited: 20,000+ active partners, $10,000+ in partner revenue generated (figure appears low/placeholder relative to other stats and may need verification with the client), 330+ markets, 230+ "partner milestones."

Source: https://finsaitrade.com/partnerships
